I’ve never been good at time since I was a high schooler. Staying up till 3am sleeping till 1pm. Skipping school to smoke cigarette left overs id find on the streets. Lying to my parents, doing things to my arms that I don’t need to spell out.

I STILL don’t pay to have the full version and it’s helped changed my life this much. 

I started going to the gym because of this app, I got on top of my dirty house for this app, I fixed my Eating disorder so I could say every night that YES I finished my goals! This app really is a gateway to change your life. All you need is the dedication to stick to it.

By taking care of the flower, the user of Eden must take care of himself. It’s sweet, and vulnerable, and something that needs protecting to flourish. Overall, though, Eden is pretty cool. It's got this chill vibe that I'm really into, and it's helping me stay on track with my goals. If they tweak the free version a bit, it could be even better. For now, though, I'd give it a solid  4 out of 5 stars

title: Could use more basic features
body:
This app is great for what it is designed for and I love how private it is. It is pleasant, encouraging, and great for tracking a handful of important goals. With that said, I still find it lacking in basic features.

The app has a streak system where, if you don't complete any tasks for a day, your flower withers. This is a really cool concept. Except that, if you don't check the app at all on the day you don't checkmark your goals, the flower does not wither at all. Yet you can reset the number of times you completed your goal manually. So if you want to meditate for 30 days without breaking, and you want to go on a streak, you can reset the number of times you meditates whenever you break that streak. Except resetting the number doesn't make the flower wither either.

It may sound funny to say, but the app isn't punishing enough for those who want to maintain a streak. If I miss a goal for one day then the app should automatically wither the flower the next time I open it. The flower should automatically wither (or start from the beginning) anytime I reset the streak. 

In short, the user should be able to define and configure their goals more than they're currently able to so that they are rewarded for maintaining a streak and punished for failing to. Otherwise, it feels as if you're being rewarded for failure (because the flower does not reset when you reset your goal).

title: Love Eden!
body:
I tried many different comparable apps in search of one that would fill this function in my life -That would allow me to track the completion of daily self-care habits and reward my success with a response that would spark joy for me.  Authentic joy.

 I tried so many apps, but nothing gave me the joy. Until I found Eden.  

I am a minimalist, I don’t like clutter, and I really appreciate beauty. There are so many apps out there that have very little beauty woven into them. 

This one really does.  

The one area I would suggest for improvement would be incorporating the option to customize the quotes.

This would allow someone to put in the words that really feel most meaningful to them as a reward. For me this would be nurturing little phrases that are specific to me.  

But if the quotes are not customizable, this is a place where I would appreciate more beauty and poetry in the app. I would like to see more quotes by artists here. The ones that are in the app currently don’t really speak to me.

But all in all, I absolutely love this app! I immediately purchased a lifetime membership, and I look forward to it being a part of my life for the duration.

Thanks so much for creating this wonderful tool.

author: Kay Sue AB

title: in love.
body:
first time giving a review to an app, but I had to after experiencing the joy of Eden. the developers did a wonder! I am so grateful that the premium is easily accessible for fixed incomes. 

the beauty radiates from this. you’re taking care of a seed. helping it grow into a flower. you’re doing this by keeping up with your tasks! what a great idea.

there’s ambient music playing that you can change to piano or lofi. there’s quotes on display. you can switch the theme to light or dark (you can even automate it to switch to both through day). you can change the background where your flower is blooming! plus, you can set a daily reminder. 

this app feels so personal. never felt that way about a self-cafe app, or any app to at all to be honest. 

thank you for this treasure. 

with love, tina.
